summary: StudentExpenseHistory is an ASP.NET user control that displays the expense receipt history for a student. It retrieves history data using an ObjectDataSource, binds that data to a Repeater control, and formats the display using HTML table rows with alternating CSS classes.
purpose: To show a list of historical expense receipts for a student, allowing users to print this history, and ensuring data security by checking user session validity.

fields.description: User session object used for access validation.

fields.name: StudentID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the student whose expense history is displayed.

steps: Page_Load event is triggered (no explicit logic shown).
If UserSession is null, selection is cancelled.
If UserSession is valid, dsHistory is passed sess and StudentID.
For each item bound, rprHistory_ItemDataBound fires.
ExpenseReceiptHistory item is retrieved for the row.
HTML table rows (trRow1, trRow2) are located and assigned CSS classes based on ListItemType (alternating for visual effect).

steps: cmdPrint button exists for print functionality (implementation not shown, presumed to trigger print of displayed history).
